t: A Roomba-based robot platform that runs ROS 2 and a beginner Python playground.
steps: Find the Create 3 documentation repository, which is the most stable resource.
Confirm that the robot is still on sale.
Connect by Bluetooth for the Python Web Playground.
Use a computer with Bluetooth to run a first program.
Ask IT to set up a ROS 2 computer and Wi-Fi network for ROS 2 work.
Follow the Getting Started with the Create 3 Robot course.
